Know what you’re looking at

This is a curated research snapshot, not a complete or live congressional trading feed. The included records come from selected 2026 filings. No prices, performance estimates or current holdings are inferred.

House records

Transactions were checked against the original House Clerk PDFs. Some filings are represented by selected rows only.

  • Pelosi · August 21, 2026 ↗ — six publicly traded asset transactions; private LLC investment excluded.
  • Pelosi · January 23, 2026 ↗ — selected purchases, exercises and sales; donations and exchange excluded.
  • Gottheimer · January 14, 2026 ↗ — nine reported sales.

Senate records

Tuberville’s five December 17, 2025 transactions are transcribed from Coldpine’s January 15 filing summary ↗. These are labeled secondary-source records. The original Senate site could not be independently read. Later amendments exist and have not been reconciled; these rows are historical, not a current position record.

Read the dates and ownership

Delay is the calendar-day gap between the trade and filing dates, not a judgment about whether a filing was late. Covered transactions generally must be reported within 30 days of notification and no later than 45 days after the transaction. House Ethics guidance ↗

Amounts are reported brackets, not execution prices or profits. Spouse, joint and self ownership remain distinct. Options and exercises are labeled separately from ordinary stock purchases.
